video_title: We'd rather have Steph Curry and Kevin Durant over KOBE BRYANT 🤯

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Charlie Villanueva defends Shaquille O'Neal as the most dominant player in history
quotes.excerpt: I have a most dominant big in the history of the fucking basketball.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: I have a most dominant big in the history of the fucking basketball. I got Michael Jordan and Kobe Bryant. I'm not worried about made shots and Kevin Durant is the most efficient player in the game of basketball.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: He's playing your four. What four man is going to guard him?

quotes.social_post: Charlie Villanueva says he is not worried about made shots when discussing the most dominant players in history, putting Michael Jordan and Kobe Bryant at the top of his list.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson argues LeBron James can play point guard in an all-time lineup
quotes.excerpt: I don't need a point guard. LeBron James can play the point.
quotes.quote: I don't need a point guard. LeBron James can play the point. If you talk who's a better point guard, Steph or Bron, be honest.
quotes.social_post: Theo Pinson makes the case for LeBron James as a point guard in an all time lineup, asking who is actually the better point guard between him and Steph Curry.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Charlie Villanueva explains why he prioritizes Kobe Bryant for his efficiency
quotes.excerpt: I don't need shot making, that's why I pick Kobe. I need the most efficient three.
quotes.quote: I don't need shot making, that's why I pick Kobe. I need the most efficient three. Kobe does similar to what Michael Jordan does. Who's better, Michael Jordan or Kobe Bryant?
quotes.social_post: Charlie Villanueva explains why he prioritizes Kobe Bryant for his efficiency, comparing his game directly to Michael Jordan.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson finalizes his all-time lineup by cutting Kevin Durant
quotes.excerpt: I'm going with LeBron at the one. MJ at the two, Kobe at the three, KD at the four.
quotes.quote: I'm going with LeBron at the one. MJ at the two, Kobe at the three, KD at the four, and Shaq at the five. I'm sorry, I love Steph to death, but Steph is getting cut.
quotes.social_post: Theo Pinson sets his all time starting five with LeBron James at the one, MJ at the two, Kobe at the three, KD at the four, and Shaq at the five, leaving Steph Curry off the roster.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Raymond Felton questions if Michael Jordan and Kobe Bryant can coexist on one team
quotes.excerpt: You don't think those two can coexist? Kobe Bryant and Michael Jordan on the same team?
quotes.quote: You don't think those two can coexist? Kobe Bryant and Michael Jordan on the same team? Somebody got to take a backseat to win. How their egos and their mentality, they call it Mamba mentality.
quotes.social_post: Raymond Felton questions if Michael Jordan and Kobe Bryant could actually coexist on the same team, citing their egos and the Mamba mentality.
